newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Uraco unit to sell factory for S$5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Uraco unit to sell factory for S$5 mln.

text.p: A unit of Singapore's Uraco Holdings Ltd has opted to sell a factory, subject to official approval, for S$5 million, the company said on Tuesday.
Uraco Die Casting Pte Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of Uraco Holdings, has given an option to Mac Electric Ptd Ltd to buy its leasehold property at No. 17 Senoko Avenue.
The option is valid until January 22, and when exercised will allow Mac Electric to buy the property for S$5 million.
The book value of the property was assessed at $2 million at the end of July last year, giving rise to an extraordinary gain of $3 million upon its disposal.
Uraco said the proceeds from the sale would be used for working capital.
It said the transaction would not have any material impact on the net tangible asset value or the net earnings per share of the Group for the current financial year ending March.
